documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited presented its financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, reporting revenue from operations of ₹2,390.7 crore and ₹4,403.5 crore respectively. The company highlighted its operational performance, including positive cash flow from operations in H1 FY27 and expansion of its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 sq. ft. Additionally, Sky Gold announced the acquisition of a 100% stake in Purvi Gems for ₹9 crore and stated that promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, receiving payouts exclusively through dividends. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,013 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 78% year-on-year growth.

guidance.claim: Following preferential allotment in FY24, the company guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: The company previously guided for revenue expected at ~₹5,000 crore for FY27.
Sky Gold aims to achieve a revenue target of INR 8,100 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company targets long-term revenues of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management expects sales growth in the range of 30% to 35%.
guidance.quote: Considering these, and my ROCE is close to 35%- 36%, we expect that we will go to 30% to 35% in terms of the sales increase.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall PAT margin to be close to 5%.
guidance.quote: And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

guidance.claim: The company targets expanding exports to 20% in coming years.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting good sales export as we have guided that we will go to 20% exports in coming years.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold revised its FY27 revenue projection upwards to approximately Rs 8,100 crore.
The company expects its EBITDA margin for FY27 to be in the range of 7.0% to 7.5%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: Sky Gold guided for a PAT margin between 4.5% and 4.75% for FY27.
By FY30, revenue is expected to reach approximately Rs 18,000 to 19,000 crore.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian jewellery industry continues to witness an increasing presence of organised manufacturers within the overall market.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian jewellery industry continues to witness an increasing presence of organised manufacturers within the overall market, creating a favourable backdrop for companies with established capabilities, scale, and customer relationships.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower Karatage products contribute nearly 14% of volume and 1.4% to 1.5% to gross margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation. They now contribute close to 14% of volume and has gross margin contribution of close to 1.4% to 1.5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Natural diamonds currently represent around 2% of overall business.
demand_outlook.quote: Further, natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of our overall business, presenting significant headroom for future growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Sky Gold has built a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across UK and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects 3% to 4% of total sales to come from the European market.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we are expecting 3% to 4% of sales coming from Europe market, and we have already started getting the orders.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold opened an office in Dubai.
Future capacity expansion after 2028 is expected to involve capex of INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores under a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Developing a new facility to expand capacity from 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons takes approximately 120 days.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it will take 120 days. We made this facility in 90 days where we are here now, and it will take 120 days to develop the factory to go to 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons and 100% it will take around INR80 crores to INR100 crores of capex

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently operates four facilities and has no active acquisition plans.
capex_expansion.quote: We have 4 facilities to utilize, and we are focusing on the products. So, as of now, there is no such anything on the table for acquisition.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,35,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The company bolstered its Dubai office team to enhance growth across the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also bolstered our Dubai office by onboarding an experienced team which will enhance our ability to serve and grow across the Middle East and Southeast Asia.

margins_costs.claim: An increased share of value-added products served as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Implementing an ERP to monitor operational KPIs led to a reduction of gold loss.
margins_costs.quote: Implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin for Q1 FY27 reached 9.3%, up 27 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 157 crores, representing a 7.8% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The Advance Gold model adds approximately 90 to 100 basis points to revenue and gross margin.
margins_costs.quote: First, the Advance Gold contributes close to 90 to 100 bps in revenue and gross margin, since this flows into the gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for 22 KT products is approximately 6% to 6.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Finally, if we look at 22 KT gross margins, it comes to close to 6% to 6.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin guidance remains in the range of 8.5% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: And again, Advance Gold, that is why we are guiding a guidance of 8.5% to 9%.

margins_costs.claim: Value-added share of business increased from under 10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Implementation of ERP monitoring led to a reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to 0.5%.
margins_costs.quote: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Quarterly production capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Volume growth for Q1 FY27 was between 7% and 9%.
orders_capacity.quote: But overall, I can say that we have grown by 7% to 9% in the volumes in this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, with all payouts coming solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flows turned positive at close to INR 30 crores in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our cash flows from operations turned positive at close to INR30 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to negative operating cash flows till the end of '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital cycle closed at approximately 60 days in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result, we are closing this quarter at approximately 60 days of our net working capital cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary model beginning FY27, relying entirely on dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital allocation priority remains focused on debt reduction before dividend distributions.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: An incident involving INR 10.7 crores occurred, with legal recovery efforts ongoing.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

risks_headwinds.claim: Company performance remains subject to risks regarding the Indian and global economies, industry performance, and market preference changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, with payouts made solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Land sale completion has been extended beyond August 2026.
Management stated that its priorities remain clear regarding sustainable growth, prudent capital allocation, and disciplined governance.
management_commitments.quote: Building on the strong foundation of Sky Gold & Diamonds Ltd., our priorities remain clear: sustainable growth, prudent capital allocation, and disciplined governance.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold commits to an FY27 revenue target of INR 8,100 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an average of 15% sales on the Advance Gold model in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We have achieved 18% Advance Gold business, and we have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning FY27, promoters will adopt a zero-salary compensation model.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold projects revenue of approximately Rs 8,100 crore for FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
